# FLXA conformance corpus

One fixture per pinned semantic of the binary audit format. The normative text is
`docs/reference/flxa-format.md`; the table there says what each fixture MUST be read as.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are generated by
`FlxaConformanceCorpus.main(<this directory>)` from the shipped writer, and
`FlxaConformanceTest.everyCommittedFixtureIsWhatTheShippedWriterProducesNow` fails if the two
disagree. A diff here is a change to the FORMAT and belongs in the specification first.

They ship in the runtime jar so that a consumer in another repository or language reads the same
bytes: `FlxaConformanceCorpus.committed(name)`.
